rows.note: Use 門禁卡 for a card that grants entry to a restricted building or area.

example.english: My badge won't let me into the building.
example.traditional: 我張門禁卡入唔到大廈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 mun4 gam3 kaa1 jap6 m4 dou2 daai6 haa6

rows.note: Use 襟章 for a physical badge or pin worn on a uniform or item of clothing.

example.english: The company requires me to wear a badge at work.
example.traditional: 公司要求我返工一定要戴襟章。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 faan1 gung1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai3 gam1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use 徽章 for an emblem awarded for an achievement, including a digital achievement badge.

example.english: Play for ten days and you get a badge.
example.traditional: 玩夠十日就攞到個徽章。
example.jyutping: waan2 gau3 sap6 jat6 zau6 lo2 dou2 go3 fai1 zoeng1

rows.note: Use 名牌 for a small name badge worn by a person for identification.

example.english: Remember to wear your badge when you check in.
example.traditional: 報到嗰陣記住戴返個名牌。
example.jyutping: bou3 dou3 go2 zan6 gei3 zyu6 daai3 faan1 go3 meng4 paai4
